question: Should wacli support `sync --presence-mode quiet` as a documented best-effort mode for personal-number mirrors?
rationale: The patch correctly implements presence suppression, but deciding whether externally influenced notification-routing behavior belongs in the supported CLI contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept best-effort quiet mode
options.body: Merge the opt-in flag with unchanged defaults and documentation that does not guarantee primary-phone notification behavior.

options.title: Decline configurable presence
options.body: Close this PR and the paired feature issue if sync should expose one fixed global presence policy.

recommendation.title: Accept best-effort quiet mode
recommendation.body: Merge the opt-in flag with unchanged defaults and documentation that does not guarantee primary-phone notification behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged the current presence lifecycle and has already been asked to decide the product direction for the new mode.
